EntityType.description:
What kind of node a passage is on the generic Work -> container -> Passage spine.

``SECTION`` and ``HYMN`` are frozen by the sealed Rigveda corpus and are NOT
renamed: in RV they mean Mandala and Sukta, in AVS Kanda and Sukta. Neither
name generalises, so works whose containers are not section/hymn-shaped --
Samaveda's Arcika/Prapathaka/Ardha/Dasati chain, four deep -- use
``STRUCTURAL_CONTAINER`` and carry their real level name in
``Passage.native_labels``. See docs/FOUR_VEDA_STRUCTURAL_MODEL.md.
EntityType.title: EntityType

description:
One addressable node on the generic ``Work -> container(s) -> Passage`` spine.

Depth is not fixed. Rigveda and Atharvaveda are three levels, Vajasaneyi is two,
Samaveda Kauthuma is five and its depth varies between arcikas. ``hierarchy``
therefore carries level-name -> value pairs rather than fixed columns, and
``native_labels`` carries the edition's own ordered level names so no work is read
through another work's vocabulary. See docs/FOUR_VEDA_STRUCTURAL_MODEL.md.
